name: dsh-frontend-craft
description: Front-end design craft for the agent: Impeccable's Apache-2.0 skill corpus (24 commands, the craft floor, the modes, the native references) vendored at a pinned commit, its 61-rule detector compiled to WebAssembly and shipped in the box, five fe_* tools (including a throwaway headless-browser render that measures contrast, tap targets and overflow), and a Frontend tab with findings, artifacts, directions and a preview. No network, no install, no engine download.
